value.rationale: Metric balls of fixed radius form a canonical concept class on Boolean cubes. The sharp dimension-independent five-mistake bound and exact first-saturation dimension six characterize online complexity even as the number of candidate centers grows exponentially. Double-ball/star decomposition is a reusable nontrivial structural mechanism beyond isolated small calculations.
